summary: Enforce the law, chase criminals, evolve your cop hero in an open-world city.
description:
Strap on your badge and dive into an open-world city that never sleeps. Any routine stop or 911 call can explode into a tire-screeching chase or tense shoot-out—you decide how to uphold the law.

◆ POLICE WORK
Issue tickets, chase thieves, foil heists, and choose—through dialogue or force—what justice looks like. Your conduct shapes reputation and rewards.
◆ LIVING CITY
Cruise streets, highways, and districts that shift with day/night, weather, and evolving crime. No two patrols play alike.
◆ PURSUITS & DRIVING
Drift tuned cruisers, drop spike strips, or go undercover in unmarked cars. Smart AI reacts to sirens and bumps.
◆ COMBAT & UPGRADES
When talk fails, draw pistol, shotgun, taser, or riot gear. Destructible cover and flanking crooks keep firefights sharp. Upgrade Health, Power, and Income to unlock new gear.
◆ PLAY OR ROAM
Follow the campaign, grind side jobs, or simply hunt secrets and mini-games. Be a by-the-book guardian or a renegade cop—the city remembers.

Are you ready to write your own police legend? The city is waiting for its next hero—sirens on and lights blazing!

IGRS rating: 13+
